summary: Fused multi-signal recall with temporal fact supersession (Total Agent Memory: BM25 full-text + local dense embeddings + fuzzy matching + knowledge graph fused by reciprocal rank fusion, local cross-encoder rerank that can be switched off for deterministic reruns; facts with validity intervals, newer value of a single-valued fact retires the older one; default profile makes no LLM call on write or search so retrieval is measurable offline; one directory per store around a SQLite database; personal/department/company areas as separate stores behind one gateway with roles, authorship, audit trail) + RWA bridge invariants and decimal discipline (rwa-lab-2026, ideas only: on-chain token is a claim on an off-chain asset, not the asset; four planks custody/attestation/redemption/permissioning; escrow conservation and settlement solvency invariants; shares 18 / NAV 8 / cash 6 decimal scales with exact conversion; attestation as the reporter's only way to move NAV, with the FalseNav question always asked) + three-file markdown kernel (agent-kernel, ideas only: generic kernel file + identity file + knowledge index; mutable facts separate from append-only daily session logs; git repo as the memory store, plain markdown source of truth, rebuildable index). Patterns restated in our own words only; no code, no network/wallet/signing/payment/API-key code, no benchmark, speed, audit, star-count, or deployment claims as fact.
